files.content:
spring:
  application:
    name: board-api
  datasource:
    # javaExperience MySQL(호스트 3306)의 project DB. 빈 DB면 Flyway가 V1으로 테이블·시드를 만든다
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/project?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community

app:
  jwt:
    # 예시용 비밀키 — 실제 서비스에서는 코드·저장소에 두지 않고 환경 변수 등으로 주입한다. HS256은 32바이트 이상
    secret: board-api-example-secret-key-change-me-0123456789
    validity-seconds: 3600

mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.board.user.UserMapper">
    <select id="existsByEmail" resultType="boolean">
        SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
    </select>
    <select id="findByEmail" resultType="org.example.board.user.User">
        SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, created_at
        FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
    </select>
    <select id="findById" resultType="org.example.board.user.User">
        SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, created_at
        FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="org.example.board.user.User" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, created_at)
        VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{createdAt})
    </insert>
</mapper>
